name: Marko Kovačić
bio:
Marko's motorsport journey began with a childhood obsession with rally racing, fuelled by his father's involvement in local events. He initially pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, believing it was the path to becoming a race engineer. However, an internship with a small touring car team revealed a talent for team management and strategy. He transitioned from technical roles to focusing on optimizing team performance and resource allocation. 

Marko is known for his meticulous planning and ability to identify and nurture talent within the team. His approach to the role of Sporting Director is centered on fostering a collaborative environment where every member feels empowered to contribute. He is a firm believer in data-driven decision-making but also values the human element in motorsport, recognizing that passion and motivation are crucial for success. He is distinctive for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to find creative solutions to complex problems, making him a valuable asset to Boutsen VDS.

Marko's distinctive ability lies in his aptitude for reading the flow of a race, making him a formidable strategist and invaluable member of the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Marko has a focused look with a strong jawline and a confident posture.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every race day with a strong cup of Croatian coffee.
